title: Bilateral context score: preregistered fresh-control calibration
statement: This initial commit freezes the complete plan and executable before observing calibration or evaluation outcomes. A later commit will freeze calibration cutoffs before evaluation.
check: Follow the embedded plan and run the script in calibrate then evaluate mode; no manuscript candidates are evaluated.

plan.hypothesis: Adding candidate right-context similarity to the proposed second component improves genuine-versus-decoy discrimination under matched immediate left contexts.

scores.eight_rule_prose: Previous P-L1-007 eight-rule prose implementation, unchanged; raw loss, not its original rank percentile.

plan.js_definition: Equal-weight Jensen-Shannon divergence, log base 2, sum only nonzero probability terms, no smoothing, raw adjacency counts including spaces. Requires nonempty distributions; singleton distributions are valid.
plan.partitioning: Calibration: first 40000 characters from refcorpus.calib_text, drop final partial word. Evaluation: refcorpus.control_text beginning at character 40000, drop first partial word, take at most 40000 further characters and drop final partial word. Surround each text with a space. These control blocks follow the prefix used in the earlier audit.
plan.pairing: Find target AB and decoy AD in words. Match word-initial and word-final position flags. Additional modes match previous glyph (left) or previous and next glyph (both). Shuffle groups and pair lists with each fixed seed. Accept edits only when starts differ by at least 3 and are not within 2 positions of a previous accepted start. Replace the target by X and decoy by Z in one shared text.
plan.eligibility: At least 40 occurrences of each engineered candidate and each proposed component A,B in the encoded text; nonempty incoming/outgoing distributions. No minimum distinct-context count. Report excluded conditions.
plan.paired_comparison: A genuine win means score(X,A,B) < score(Z,A,B) - 1e-12. Reverse inequality is a decoy win; otherwise tie. Report by language and contrast; seeds are robustness replicates, not independent samples.
plan.threshold: For each score, pool eligible calibration primary-condition decoy losses. Sort n losses; set cutoff to loss at zero-based index floor(0.05*n). Accept only loss < cutoff - 1e-12. This attains at most 5% empirical calibration decoy acceptance, allowing ties. Freeze cutoff file and its digest in the public branch before evaluating controls. If no eligible calibration negatives exist, report unavailable and do not improvise.
plan.negative_controls: On untouched evaluation streams and 20 new direct-emission first-order character chains per language, score every letter C not A or B with at least 40 occurrences, using the same fixed components and cutoff. Fit chains on the first 40000 complete-word characters of refcorpus.train_text. Emit exactly 40000 glyphs from one table with sampled starts; end on a nonspace glyph. Each case has no pair-fusion operation. Report candidate-level counts and sample-level any-acceptance separately; samples/contrasts share data.
plan.manuscript_gate: Do not evaluate manuscript candidate triplets in this experiment. A positive result on these selected controls would still need new language/text and scan validation.
plan.stop_rule: No weight, contrast, seed, cutoff rule, sample window, support or matching change after observing outcome. Bugs require a documented amendment and a new plan hash.
